name: B10-0525/2026 (ECR) – Soutien à la candidature de villes de l'Union pour accueillir un nouveau pôle des Nations unies pour l’évaluation indépendante et la gouvernance éthique de l’IA
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating a position. It supports creating a new United Nations body to test artificial intelligence systems independently, using clear ethical standards, and to recognise each country's assessments. It backs the Italian city of Milan to host this body, while leaving the door open to other European cities. It also asks the European Commission and member states to push for a European host within the United Nations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is an opinion, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** European Union governments, the Commission, and the United Nations.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and governments are asked to promote a European host in United Nations talks.
